concept.material: polished bog oak and tarnished silver plate with blued steel rivets
concept.internal_detail: articulated rib racks, coiled steel hairsprings, and micro-toothed drive racks
concept.button: a small flush silver bead inlaid with a ring of cold blue enamel
concept.shell_mechanic: The flattened paraboloid hull glides upward on internal vertical twin guide rails
concept.emerging_parts: A pair of segmented tail rami, three dark lens plates, and twelve articulated leaf-like paddling appendages
concept.signature_move: its leaf-like paddle appendages cycle once in a forward wave along their side pins, and its jointed tail spine flexes upward on its hinge
concept.turkish: Triops (üç gözlü tarih öncesi tatlı su kabuklusu) — yassı parabolik zırh, bataklık meşesi ve karartılmış gümüş

concept.material: brushed gunmetal and warm nickel-plated brass with inset carnelian plates
concept.internal_detail: twin counter-rotating bevel gearsets, hair-thin escapement wires, and miniature brass ratchets
concept.button: a circular knurled nickel pin rimmed with a narrow copper washer
concept.shell_mechanic: The domed pentagonal vault divides along its central keel seam and swings outward on twin leaf hinges to form folded flank feathers
concept.emerging_parts: A jointed neck stalk bearing a tall laterally-compressed grooved bill plate and two webbed brass foot struts
concept.signature_move: its hinged orange bill plate snaps shut with a crisp click, and its head turns forty-five degrees to the left on its swivel collar pin
concept.turkish: Boynuzlu martı (kalın gagalı deniz kuşu) — kubbeli beşgen tonoz, fırçalanmış tunç ve nikel kaplı pirinç

concept.material: hand-carved pale hornblende stone and dark patinated gunmetal
concept.internal_detail: nested coaxial planetary gear rings, miniature brass pawls, and leaf-spring pivots
concept.button: a domed matte black steel stud seated in an off-centre counterbore
concept.button_short: the domed matte black steel stud
concept.shell_mechanic: The fluted oblate disc splits into five radial wedges that hinge outward five degrees from its central vertical axis
concept.emerging_parts: Thirty slender jointed brass spine needles and a central five-jawed miniature Aristotle's lantern armature
concept.signature_move: its radiating needle spines twitch three degrees outward in unison, and its bottom five-jawed brass lantern fixture ratchets closed with a soft metallic click
concept.turkish: Deniz kestanesi (dikenli yuvarlak deniz canlısı) — yivli yassı yuvarlak gövde, soluk hornblend taşı ve patineli tunç
